label: Conversational writing
summary: Conversational writing is one of the core skills that conversation design requires. It means writing the way people actually talk: not in sentences and paragraphs, but in the rhythms and conventions of spoken language. Even text-based bots are treated as a spoken medium, which means the writing rules are different from traditional copywriting or content work.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike frames conversational writing as a distinct discipline that sits inside the broader conversation designer skillset. She is specific that it is not just 'writing' and not just 'talking', but writing the way you talk, with its own style rules, conventions, and structures. This shows up practically in her work through things like tone of voice decisions, bot personas, and style guides, all of which depend on getting the conversational register right.
